advice.why: Coming to your work short on knowing the genre cost each piece about 3.3 points off the whole. That’s preparation, not training: prepare that part further before you show or tape the next piece.

Tiring through a piece’s later moments cost each one about 0.8 points off the whole. Stamina is your fitness, and Work Out, under Look After Yourself, builds it. Places to breathe in a piece leave less of it to drain, and on a night so does coming to the curtain rested. Rest restores energy, not fitness.

20 hours of its exercise, an hour a day, would take it from 93 to about 95. On your recent work, judged again as you are now, that’s forecast to be worth about 0.5 points a piece (your last 12 pieces all call on it; The Pressure Certificate (The Bluff), Taped would gain most, about +0.5). About 0.1 of that comes from the discipline 20 days of practice build, which any exercise kept up daily would bring too. Set Focus to Steady to start. Spaced pays more once your last session is a day to a week old.
